justification: Every source unit is an explicit AnCora newdoc group. The two non-overlapping prefixes identify separately named upstream corpora rather than post hoc random splits. Selection used only repository metadata, UD text/labels, and document counts; no activation or endpoint outcome was inspected.
joint_component_rule: Each source partition must independently provide at least 64 document-disjoint joint context-plus-lexical components using the frozen builder. If either fails, stop prescore-ineligible without replacement or model forward.
limitations: Both source partitions share one UD treebank release and annotation pipeline.
The transfer test is across upstream corpora, not across independently maintained treebanks.
